title: Reconstruction of Machine-Made Shapes from Bitmap Sketches
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper presents a system for reconstructing 3D machine-made shapes from bitmap sketches. It involves separating the input image into patches, optimizing geometry, and using neural networks to estimate depth and segmentation. The system preserves the drawn strokes and introduces sharp ridges and occlusions into the final shape.
